sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "battery_types" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "type_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "chemistry" TEXT NULL, "default_voltage" REAL NULL, "default_capacity" REAL NULL, "capacity_unit" TEXT NULL, "physical_size" TEXT NULL, "suggested_icon_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'builtin', "suggested_icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'battery_generic', "suggested_icon_color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#607D8B', "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deactivated_at" TEXT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(type_name)) > 0), CHECK (default_voltage IS NULL OR default_voltage >= 0), CHECK (default_capacity IS NULL OR default_capacity >= 0), CHECK (suggested_icon_source IN ('builtin', 'custom')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "battery_batches" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "batch_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "purchase_date" TEXT NULL, "purchase_location" TEXT NULL, "total_purchase_price" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(batch_code)) > 0), CHECK (total_purchase_price IS NULL OR total_purchase_price >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "batteries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "user_battery_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "battery_type_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES battery_types (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "batch_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES battery_batches (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "manufacturer" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "serial_number" TEXT NULL, "custom_label" TEXT NULL, "chemistry" TEXT NULL, "nominal_voltage" REAL NULL, "capacity" REAL NULL, "capacity_unit" TEXT NULL, "rechargeable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("rechargeable" IN (0, 1)), "purchase_date" TEXT NULL, "purchase_location" TEXT NULL, "purchase_price" REAL NULL, "total_package_price" REAL NULL, "per_battery_price" REAL NULL, "warranty_expiration" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Available', "condition" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'New', "condition_note" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "icon_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'builtin', "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'battery_generic', "icon_color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#607D8B', "preferred_primary_visual" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'icon', "estimated_charge_percent" INTEGER NULL, "retired_at" TEXT NULL, "retirement_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(user_battery_id)) > 0), CHECK (nominal_voltage IS NULL OR nominal_voltage >= 0), CHECK (capacity IS NULL OR capacity >= 0), CHECK (purchase_price IS NULL OR purchase_price >= 0), CHECK (total_package_price IS NULL OR total_package_price >= 0), CHECK (per_battery_price IS NULL OR per_battery_price >= 0), CHECK (estimated_charge_percent IS NULL OR (estimated_charge_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100)), CHECK (icon_source IN ('builtin', 'custom')), CHECK (preferred_primary_visual IN ('icon', 'photo')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "battery_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "user_set_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "battery_type_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES battery_types (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "description" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "icon_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'builtin', "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'battery_set_generic', "icon_color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#607D8B', "preferred_primary_visual" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'icon', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deactivated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(user_set_id)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), CHECK (icon_source IN ('builtin', 'custom')), CHECK (preferred_primary_visual IN ('icon', 'photo')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "battery_set_memberships" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "battery_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES batteries (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "battery_set_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES battery_sets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "added_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "removed_at" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "operation_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (removed_at IS NULL OR removed_at >= added_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "manufacturer" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "serial_number" TEXT NULL, "location" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "required_battery_type_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES battery_types (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "required_battery_quantity" INTEGER NULL, "required_voltage" REAL NULL, "requirement_notes" TEXT NULL, "icon_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'builtin', "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'device_generic', "icon_color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#607D8B', "preferred_primary_visual" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'icon', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deactivated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), CHECK (required_battery_quantity IS NULL OR required_battery_quantity > 0), CHECK (required_voltage IS NULL OR required_voltage >= 0), CHECK (icon_source IN ('builtin', 'custom')), CHECK (preferred_primary_visual IN ('icon', 'photo')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assignments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "subject_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "battery_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES batteries (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "battery_set_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES battery_sets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "device_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_set_assignment_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "operation_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "assigned_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "removed_at" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "override_reason" TEXT NULL, CHECK (subject_type IN ('battery', 'battery_set')), CHECK ((subject_type = 'battery' AND battery_id IS NOT NULL AND battery_set_id IS NULL) OR (subject_type = 'battery_set' AND battery_id IS NULL AND battery_set_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (removed_at IS NULL OR removed_at >= assigned_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "set_charge_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "battery_set_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES battery_sets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "charged_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "charge_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "battery_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES batteries (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "charged_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "starting_charge_percent" INTEGER NULL, "ending_charge_percent" INTEGER NULL, "charger" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "source_set_charge_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES set_charge_records (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "bulk_operation_uuid" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (starting_charge_percent IS NULL OR (starting_charge_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100)), CHECK (ending_charge_percent IS NULL OR (ending_charge_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_assets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "original_filename" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "missing_at" TEXT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(relative_path)) > 0), CHECK (byte_size >= 0), CHECK (width IS NULL OR width > 0), CHECK (height IS NULL OR height > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "battery_photos" ("battery_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES batteries (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "media_asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES media_assets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "is_primary" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_primary" IN (0, 1)), "display_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "caption" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("battery_id", "media_asset_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "battery_set_photos" ("battery_set_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES battery_sets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "media_asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES media_assets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "is_primary" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_primary" IN (0, 1)), "display_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "caption" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("battery_set_id", "media_asset_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_photos" ("device_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "media_asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES media_assets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "is_primary" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_primary" IN (0, 1)), "display_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "caption" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "media_asset_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "icon_categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deactivated_at" TEXT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), CHECK (scope IN ('battery', 'battery_set', 'device', 'general')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_icons" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES icon_categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "file_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "supports_color" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("supports_color" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deactivated_at" TEXT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), CHECK (file_type IN ('png', 'svg')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "battery_tags" ("battery_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES batteries (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("battery_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "qr_label_templates" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "width_points" REAL NOT NULL, "height_points" REAL NOT NULL, "layout_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deactivated_at" TEXT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), CHECK (target_type IN ('battery', 'battery_set', 'device')), CHECK (width_points > 0), CHECK (height_points > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_log" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "related_entity_type" TEXT NULL, "related_entity_uuid" TEXT NULL, "operation_uuid" TEXT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "metadata_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(event_type)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(entity_type)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(summary)) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("setting_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("setting_key"), CHECK (length(trim(setting_key)) > 0), CHECK (value_type IN ('string', 'integer', 'real', 'boolean', 'json')));
